newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana stock exchange rises in moderate trade.
newsitem.headline: Ghana stock exchange rises in moderate trade.

text.p: The Ghana Stock Exchange index rose on Monday despite losses by Enterprise Insurance Company, which fell 100 cedis to 500 cedis, and Accra Brewery Limited, down 2 to 606.
The Ghana All-Share index edged up by 0.56 points to 370.14 from 369.58 on Friday.
Trade was moderate, with 41,760 shares changing hands and bids outstripping offers by 5,342,760 to 350,460.
The four risers were Social Security Bank (+5 to 1265), Super Paper Products Company (+5 to 110), Ghana Commercial Bank (+2 to 612) and Unilever (+1 to 848).
One trader said market sentiment was improving after end of year company results showed good turnover.
"Individual small investors seem to be gaining renewed confidence after the year opened with uncertainty," he said. "This should see the market picking up strongly in the year."
